entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David; when he was in the wilderness of Judah.>> O God, thou art my *God; early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh languisheth for thee, in a dry and weary land without water:

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: To see thy power and thy glory, as I have beheld thee in the sanctuary;

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: ¶For thy loving-kindness is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: So will I bless thee while I live; I will lift up my hands in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, and my mouth shall praise [thee] with joyful lips.

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: When I remember thee upon my bed, I meditate on thee in the night-watches:

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: ¶For thou hast been my help, and in the shadow of thy wings will I sing for joy.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those that seek my soul, to destroy [it], shall go into the lower parts of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They shall be given over to the power of the sword; they shall be the portion of foxes.

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: for the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
